# Usability and Recovery Checklist: Chatter and Model-Enabled Rivet Scenarios

**Purpose**: Review whether requirements define understandable engineering presentation, accessibility, bounded progress/cancellation, stable failures, restart, and recovery for the complete journey.
**Created**: 2026-08-13
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command as a formal PR-review requirements gate. It evaluates the writing, not implementation behavior.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are inspection, import, test, enable, result, preflight, review, run, progress, cancel, report, comparison, disable, removal, and recovery states all covered by user-facing requirements? [Completeness, Spec §User Stories 1–5, §NFR-006]
- [x] CHK002 Are loading, empty, blocked, incompatible, stale, failed, cancelling, cancelled-clean, cancelled-residue, and interrupted states defined for each affected journey? [Completeness, Spec §FR-029–FR-032, §NFR-007]
- [x] CHK003 Are user-facing notices required for internal terms, simulation-only status, uncalibrated score, applicability, limitations, human review, and no machine authority? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, §FR-013–FR-015, §FR-025]
- [x] CHK004 Are evidence details and comparison differences required at an understandable level without exposing paths, credentials, private rows, arrays, or reusable authority? [Completeness, Spec §FR-026–FR-028, §FR-034]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK005 Are stable failure categories paired with specific, safe, and non-destructive recovery actions for every enumerated model/scenario failure? [Clarity, Spec §FR-031]
- [x] CHK006 Is the distinction between compatibility, readiness, applicability, engineering-invariant outcome, and overall scenario state defined for users? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009, §FR-012, §FR-016, §FR-021]
- [x] CHK007 Are cancellation acknowledgement, cleanup state, possible residue, and inspect-before-retry language unambiguous? [Clarity, Spec §FR-030–FR-032, §NFR-003]
- [x] CHK008 Is the allowed advisory selection terminology specified consistently across report, export, comparison, and UI requirements? [Clarity, Spec §FR-025, §SC-004]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK009 Are error/recovery requirements consistent between model library, gateway/Rivet run, scenario report, exported evidence, and UI? [Consistency, Spec §FR-029–FR-034]
- [x] CHK010 Are timeout and cancellation targets consistent across cold inference, scenario duration, adapter delivery, and cleanup requirements? [Consistency, Spec §NFR-001–NFR-003, §SC-009]
- [x] CHK011 Are offline/air-gapped requirements consistent across inspection, import, test, inference, scenario execution, evidence, disable, and removal? [Consistency, Spec §NFR-008]
- [x] CHK012 Are accessibility requirements applied consistently to every named journey rather than only the final report? [Consistency, Spec §NFR-006, §SC-010]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK013 Are keyboard, focus, narrow-width, 200% zoom, non-color status, and automated accessibility criteria objectively stated for all critical states? [Measurability, Spec §NFR-006, §SC-010]
- [x] CHK014 Are performance criteria tied to a reference host, batch size, cold/warm condition, percentile, and excluded installation work? [Measurability, Spec §NFR-001–NFR-002]
- [x] CHK015 Are cancellation and cleanup criteria measurable in both clean and residue outcomes without allowing an unbounded “best effort”? [Measurability, Spec §NFR-003, §SC-009]
- [x] CHK016 Are record/item/string/encoded-byte ceilings required for requests, outputs, events, logs, reports, and evidence? [Measurability, Spec §NFR-005]

## Scenario and Edge-Case Coverage

- [x] CHK017 Are restart requirements defined for interruption after each durable model/scenario transition, including authority invalidation and no false success? [Coverage, Recovery, Spec §NFR-007]
- [x] CHK018 Are retry requirements defined after stale review, failed vector, insufficient resources, crash, timeout, cancellation, and possible residue? [Coverage, Spec §FR-031, §NFR-007]
- [x] CHK019 Are zero eligible candidates, partial provider evidence, truncated records, duplicate candidate labels, and changed material identity covered in report/comparison requirements? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-028, §NFR-005]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [x] CHK020 Are reference-host, local runtime, private package availability, existing UI patterns, and offline fixture assumptions documented with a user-visible blocked state when absent? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, §FR-009, §FR-022]

- Check items off as completed: `[x]`
